queries.all_databases: (every database, read in the maintenance database)
queries.reset_warning: The statistics pg_stat_statements has gathered so far will be discarded.
queries.reset_done: The query statistics have been reset.
queries.calls_since_reset: Statement calls since the statistics were reset: {{total}}
queries.top: The top {{shown}} of {{total}} statements are listed.
queries.none: pg_stat_statements has not counted any statement yet.
queries.not_available: Query statistics come from the pg_stat_statements extension, which is not available on this server: its files (PostgreSQL's contrib modules) are not installed.
queries.not_installed: Query statistics come from the pg_stat_statements extension, which is not installed in the database "{{database}}". Create it on the database's Extensions list, or run CREATE EXTENSION pg_stat_statements; there; to see every database's statements, create it in the maintenance database.
queries.not_loaded: pg_stat_statements is installed, but its library is not loaded: add pg_stat_statements to shared_preload_libraries and restart the server.

database.numbackends: Number of backends currently connected to the database (to every database when they are summed).
database.xact_commit: Number of transactions that have been committed.
database.xact_rollback: Number of transactions that have been rolled back.
database.blks_read: Number of disk blocks read because they were not in the buffer cache. Shown in red when more than 10% of the block reads missed the cache.
database.blks_hit: Number of times disk blocks were found already in the buffer cache, so that a read was not necessary (only hits in the PostgreSQL buffer cache, not in the operating system's file system cache).
database.tup_returned: Number of live rows fetched by sequential scans and index entries returned by index scans.
database.tup_fetched: Number of live rows fetched by index scans.
database.tup_inserted: Number of rows inserted by queries.
database.tup_updated: Number of rows updated by queries.
database.tup_deleted: Number of rows deleted by queries.
database.conflicts: Number of queries canceled due to conflicts with recovery (on standby servers only).
database.temp_files: Number of temporary files created by queries, whatever the reason (sorting, hashing) and whatever log_temp_files says.
database.temp_bytes: Total amount of data, in bytes, written to temporary files by queries.
database.checksum_failures: Number of data page checksum failures detected (when data checksums are enabled).
database.checksum_last_failure: Time at which the last data page checksum failure was detected.
database.blk_read_time: Time spent reading data file blocks by backends, in milliseconds (0 unless track_io_timing is on).
database.blk_write_time: Time spent writing data file blocks by backends, in milliseconds (0 unless track_io_timing is on).
database.session_time: Time spent by database sessions, in milliseconds.
database.active_time: Time spent executing SQL statements, in milliseconds.
database.idle_in_transaction_time: Time spent idling while in a transaction, in milliseconds.
database.sessions_abandoned: Number of sessions that were terminated because the connection to the client was lost.
database.sessions_fatal: Number of sessions that were terminated by fatal errors.
database.sessions_killed: Number of sessions that were terminated by operator intervention.
database.parallel_workers_to_launch: Number of parallel workers planned to be launched by queries.
database.parallel_workers_launched: Number of parallel workers launched by queries.
database.stats_reset: Time at which these statistics were last reset (the earliest of the databases when they are summed).

bgwriter.buffers_clean: Number of buffers written by the background writer.
bgwriter.maxwritten_clean: Number of times the background writer stopped a cleaning scan because it had written too many buffers (bgwriter_lru_maxpages).
bgwriter.checkpoints_timed: Number of scheduled checkpoints that have been performed.
bgwriter.checkpoints_req: Number of requested checkpoints that have been performed. Shown in red when there are more than scheduled ones: max_wal_size may be too small.
bgwriter.checkpoint_write_time: Time spent in the part of checkpoint processing where files are written to disk, in milliseconds.
bgwriter.checkpoint_sync_time: Time spent in the part of checkpoint processing where files are synchronized to disk, in milliseconds.
bgwriter.buffers_checkpoint: Number of buffers written during checkpoints.
bgwriter.buffers_backend: Number of buffers written directly by a backend.
bgwriter.buffers_backend_fsync: Number of times a backend had to execute its own fsync call (normally the background writer handles those).
bgwriter.stats_reset: Time at which the background writer's statistics were last reset.

checkpointer.num_timed: Number of scheduled checkpoints due to timeout.
checkpointer.num_requested: Number of requested checkpoints. Shown in red when there are more than scheduled ones: max_wal_size may be too small.
checkpointer.num_done: Number of checkpoints that have been performed.
checkpointer.restartpoints_timed: Number of scheduled restartpoints due to timeout or after a failed attempt to perform it.
checkpointer.restartpoints_done: Number of restartpoints that have been performed.
checkpointer.write_time: Time spent in the part of processing checkpoints and restartpoints where files are written to disk, in milliseconds.
checkpointer.sync_time: Time spent in the part of processing checkpoints and restartpoints where files are synchronized to disk, in milliseconds.
checkpointer.buffers_written: Number of shared buffers written during checkpoints and restartpoints.
checkpointer.slru_written: Number of SLRU buffers written during checkpoints and restartpoints.
checkpointer.stats_reset: Time at which the checkpointer's statistics were last reset.

prepared.disabled: max_prepared_transactions is 0 on this server, so no transaction can be prepared for two-phase commit. Raise it under Variables; it takes effect after a restart.

done.commit: The prepared transaction {{gid}} has been committed.
done.rollback: The prepared transaction {{gid}} has been rolled back.
